name: playbooks
description: Doctrine and knowledge playbooks as on-demand skills: boris (Boris Cherny's Claude Code workflow tips, howborisusesclaudecode.com), skill-authoring (Anthropic's internal skill-authoring playbook), fable-5 (Claude Fable 5's operating doctrine, self-authored), and repo-sweep (runs a catalog of hygiene skills through a repository one commit per step). boris and skill-authoring vendor a verbatim upstream baseline; /playbooks:update drift-checks and syncs them (maintainers).
